description: This file is a PHP plugin for the Smarty templating engine, specifically a modifier plugin named 'default_date_value'. It provides functionality to return a default date value based on a field's default setting, used in dynamic date fields within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. The file also contains licensing and project information in comments.

classes.name: TemplateDate
classes.description: Represents a template for date fields, used to retrieve date string configurations.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_default_date_value
methods.description: Returns a default date value as a string, given a default value setting for a date field. It utilizes the TemplateDate class and the global $timedate object.
